Stretch Routine Generator

Pick a focus area and duration to get an ordered stretching routine with timed steps and instructions.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Stretch to mild tension only, never through sharp pain.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a focus area: neck, back, legs, or full body.
  2. Choose a routine duration.
  3. Press Generate routine.
  4. Follow the ordered steps, one timed stretch at a time.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How long should I hold each stretch?

Hold static stretches 20–30 seconds per side and never bounce. Stretch to mild tension, never sharp pain.

Can I change the duration?

Yes — the routine scales its steps to fill the 5, 10, or 15 minutes you choose.

Before or after a workout?

Static stretching is best after activity or as a standalone session; use dynamic movement before intense exercise.
